_doc: Notable price events for the Cost Index — the DETECTION half. Per ingredient, the top 6 biggest SUSTAINED departures from local normal over the committed deep price history: date, direction, % vs the centered ±26-week normal, the printed price, how long the move held (durationDays), whether it lands in the item’s own high season (inHighSeason), and which other ingredients moved the same way at the same time (cohort). Pure arithmetic — no cause, no forecast, no invented number, no Pettitt "market step". The WHY is the hand-curated, source-gated data/cost-index-event-notes.json; nothing unverified renders. The level is 3-week-median-smoothed so a lone glitch cannot manufacture an event, and a move must clear 20% to qualify. Built by scripts/build-cost-index-events.mjs; CI re-checks with --check.
